_meta.method: Flat 7-mood taxonomy for TRACK-level lyrics profiling. Replaces the deep emotion-tree descent used for tracks (see the mood-profiling-accuracy change): experiments on 30 hand-labeled tracks (see backend/eval/ and the change history) showed a single flat mood choice reaches ~50% accuracy vs. ~25% for the 4-level emotion-tree family pick, and a binary positive/negative polarity choice reaches ~83%. `criterion` is the exact short English wording style ('Themes of ...') used in that experiment. `families` lists every `mood_dj/data/emotions.json` family id that maps to this mood -- every emotions.json family maps to exactly one mood here (validated by `mood_dj.domain.moods`). Prompt-side analysis still descends the full emotion tree (it measurably works better there); `mood_dj.domain.moods.family_to_mood` is the bridge used to resolve a prompt's detected emotion family into the same mood space tracks live in.
_meta.valence_arousal_centroids: Centroids are the mean of this mood's mapped families' emotions.json centroids (both in [-1, 1], Russell's circumplex model), not independently measured.
